answer: Clone auditors filed stock photos for unvisited grain bins. A grade posts after lowering a 37-cm spiral auger through the hatch, seating an 18-gram kernel cup at 1.4 m and 2.8 m, flashing a 9-cm mirror across the sleeve, and posting the 64-byte hash of a 16-second clip within 11 minutes, locking 29 POA for 9 epochs. Five hands re-hash the 400-frame file in 0.5 seconds and must match cup mass within 0.25 g. One key may grade 1 bin per epoch, so 64 aliases lock 1,856 POA. Reused auger serial, or two clips whose mirror frames agree on 14 of 16 seconds, burns 17 POA and bars that key for 8 epochs.
